newsitem.title: CHINA: Northwestern China firm to produce urea, ammonia.
newsitem.headline: Northwestern China firm to produce urea, ammonia.

text.p: China has set up a new enterprise that will have annual production capacity of 80,000 tonnes of synthetic ammonia and 130,000 tonnes of urea, the Market Daily said on Thursday.

The new plant was the first phase project of the newly formed Shaanxi-Gansu Natural Gas Co Ltd and would have total investment of 514 million yuan ($63.1 million), it said. It would begin production in 1999.
Total investment in the Longdong Petrochemical base would be 3.38 billion yuan, it said but gave no further details.
The firm would begin construction this year of a 350 km gas pipeline to transport gas from northwestern Shaanxi province to neighbouring Gansu province, it said.
The pipeline would have the capacity for 300 million cubic metres a year, it said but gave no further details.
